definitions.explanation: A person who has placed high enough in a contest or competition to receive a prize or award. Includes not only the top winner but anyone awarded a recognized rank or honor.

examples.japanese: {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賞金|しょうきん}→賞金：14234_shoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{贈|おく}られる→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Prize money is awarded to the winners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壇上|だんじょう}→壇上：21719_danjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧、⟦{記念|きねん}{写真|しゃしん}→記念写真：23222_kinenshashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: The winners of the essay contest lined up on stage and took a commemorative photo.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{入賞|にゅうしょう}→入賞：11670_nyuushou⟧ (winning a prize) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to anyone awarded a rank, not only the top winner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: announcement of winners
- {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of prize winners
- ⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}: contest winners
- {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to be chosen as a prize winner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}→受賞者：24174_jushousha⟧: award winner — broader; used for named awards and prizes (Nobel, etc.)
- ⟦{優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}→優勝者：21822_yuushousha⟧: champion; first-place winner — specifically the top finisher
